Repeated link article

Repeated references are normal in prose. Read the handbook, then read the handbook again. These are two occurrences of one address and must keep separate identities.

A single link can span styles: the complete guide. Its fragments share one occurrence even though their styling differs.

Adjacent links with the same address remain distinct: FAQFAQ. Text between them does not merge them: API and API reference.

External and relative links coexist: external, local, external again, and local again.

Repeated paragraph. repeat link appears in the same words and should still create a new occurrence when it appears in a new block.

Repeated paragraph. repeat link appears in the same words and should still create a new occurrence when it appears in a new block.

Links inside emphasis keep their address and occurrence: styled link, styled link.

An image and a link can share a sentence: followed by the same target.

The final paragraph repeats the first address once more: handbook. The comparison must count occurrences, not merely unique addresses.
